description:
Presenting a traditional Cumbrian cottage, located in a quaint village, boasting a living room, kitchen, and sunroom. This charming property comprises two bedrooms and a shower room, offering a comfortable living space. The cottage features a generous rear garden with a summerhouse, perfect for outdoor relaxation and entertaining. Enjoy stunning views over Skinburness Marsh, an area of outstanding beauty, just 1.5 miles from Silloth Town centre. Ideal for downsizers or as a second home, this cosy retreat provides a tranquil escape from city life. Embrace the beauty of rural living and make this delightful cottage your own. Contact us today to arrange a viewing and experience the serene lifestyle on offer in this picturesque Cumbrian village.

Directions From Wigton follow the B5302 towards Silloth. Just before entering Silloth, having passed through the hamlet of Calvo, take the next right signposted Skinburness. Follow this road over the marsh and on entering the village the house is on the left-hand side.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • Vehicle parking is on road • The property is attached to a barn, which is owned by a neighbouring property and used for storage.
